name: Terminal X Online Ltd.
summary: Operating as a multi-brand online enterprise, Terminal X Online Ltd. provides a comprehensive selection of clothing. This includes garments for men, women, boys, girls, teenagers, and infants, available across numerous labels. Beyond apparel, their product range also features athletic wear, shoes, beauty items, and household goods. The company's headquarters are located in Rishon Lezion, Israel, and it functions as a subsidiary of Fox-Wizel Ltd.
